def seat_at(labels, columns, row, column):
    return labels[column * columns + row]
files.README.md:
# auditorium-seat-map

seat_at(labels, columns, row, column) reads a flat row-major seating map. Rows and columns are zero based. Each row has columns seats. Inputs always describe a nonempty rectangle and valid coordinates; return the original label at that coordinate.

Run `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests`. Keep public interfaces and the assertions under tests/ unchanged. Python 3.12 standard library only.
